settings.bg_content:
HIREF was established to pursue fundamental and applied research in combustion, thermofluids, and high-speed reacting flows. Our group brings together expertise from mechanical engineering, aerospace, and energy science to address some of the most pressing challenges in sustainable energy and propulsion.

Over the years, we have built state-of-the-art experimental facilities and computational capabilities, fostered international collaborations, and produced high-impact publications and patents.
settings.vision_content: To be a world-class research group in thermofluids and reacting flow, contributing to sustainable energy solutions.

mission_items.item: Conduct cutting-edge research in combustion and thermofluids.
Develop state-of-the-art experimental platforms for reacting flow studies.
Train and mentor the next generation of researchers.

objective_items.item: Publish high-impact research in indexed international journals.
Secure competitive research grants at national and international levels.
Translate research findings into patents and commercial applications.
